NBA|4277813|pra.note: Not on New Orleans' injury report, while Murphy, Murray, Mathurin and Watford are all out, so his minutes and usage should be high, which works against the under.

CFB-week.summary: A midweek slate of three games: Akron at UMass and Central Michigan at Buffalo on Wednesday, Rice at Temple on Thursday. Covers posted props for the two MAC games, but none for Rice-Temple. The packet's QBs are out of date for both CMU (Jadyn Glasser has replaced Angel Flores) and Buffalo (Jason Wright starts, not Elijah Holmes).

NBA-ATL-at-OKC-1119.summary: Atlanta is without both primary point guards, CJ McCollum (calf, at least four weeks) and rookie Kingston Flemings (back), plus Landale, Newell and Gueye, so Alexander-Walker moves to the point. Oklahoma City is missing Jalen Williams, Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Sorber and Jaylin Williams, leaving Gilgeous-Alexander as the lone primary creator. OKC is about -6.5 (opened -7.5) with a 228 total (opened 225.5).

NBA-BOS-at-DEN-1119.summary: Both teams are close to full strength: Queta returns from a rest day for Boston (11-3, coming off a loss to Orlando) and Denver is missing only Julian Strawther. Boston is a 2.5-point road favorite, total 222.

NBA-CHI-at-BKN-1119.summary: Two 3-10 teams; Brooklyn has a clean report while Chicago is without forwards Caleb Wilson (4-6 weeks) and Tobe Awaka, with Patrick Williams probable after a finger dislocation. Jalen Smith hit his head Monday but is off the report. Nets are 2.5-point favorites and the total rose from 236.5 to 238.5.

NBA-DET-at-NO-1119.summary: Detroit is again without Jalen Duren, Duncan Robinson, Isaiah Joe, Ronald Holland II and Taurean Prince, which keeps Daniss Jenkins in the starting backcourt and thins out the team's shooting. New Orleans is missing Trey Murphy III, Dejounte Murray, Trendon Watford and Bryce McGowens (Mathurin listed day-to-day on one page, out per the packet). Detroit has moved from -6.5 to -7.5 with the total near 228.5, so blowout minutes are possible.

NBA-HOU-at-IND-1119.summary: Houston (11-4) is short-handed at guard and center: Capela out again, Smart suspended, Adams and Amen Thompson questionable, with Eason starting if Thompson sits. Indiana (5-9) is without Haliburton, Sheppard and Furphy, and Nembhard (hip) is questionable after Quenton Jackson started for him Sunday. Houston is a road favorite of about 7.5 with a 224 total.

NBA-MEM-at-CLE-1119.summary: Cleveland is thin: Mobley (toe) and Merrill (elbow) are out, Tyson (ankle) is doubtful and Watson (back) questionable, leaving Harden and Mitchell with heavy on-ball loads. Memphis is without Jerome, Pippen, Stewart and GG Jackson, so Cam Spencer starts at point guard. Cleveland is about a 4.5-point favorite (opened 5.5) with a 235 total.

NBA-PHI-at-ORL-1119.summary: Philadelphia is without Jaylen Brown (left hamstring strain), Adem Bona and Dominick Barlow, while LeBron James and Joel Embiid are off the injury report and expected to play. Orlando is still without Paolo Banchero (high-ankle sprain, 4-6 weeks), Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Izaiyah Nelson. The market has PHI around -2 with a total near 222.

NBA-WSH-at-TOR-1119.summary: Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee) and Nate Bittle (foot); Scottie Barnes returned on Nov. 15 from a four-game groin strain (30 points vs. New York) and is still listed day-to-day. Washington is missing Vukcevic, Champagnie, Beekman and Watkins and has lost eight straight. Toronto is about -6.5 with a 228.5 total (opened 227).

NFL-IND-at-HOU-1120.summary: Houston's backfield is in flux on a short week: Woody Marks (concussion) is doubtful, Jawhar Jordan is on the practice-squad injured list until Nov 29, and David Montgomery (groin, out since Week 5) practiced fully Monday and Tuesday with no designation posted yet, with Demercado the fallback lead back. Texans WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) missed Monday and Tuesday sessions; Indianapolis has both starting tackles hurt (Raimann concussion, Travis doubtful) and both top corners questionable. Spread quotes vary widely (Circa -12.5, DraftKings -9.5 on Nov 16), total 44.5-45.5, indoors.

SOCCER-day.summary: Santos travel to Coritiba missing their first-choice keeper, two defenders and three call-ups; Palmeiras arrive at Cruzeiro without Gomez, Piquerez and Murilo. Plata is not in Flamengo's projected XI after leaving the Ecuador camp, and Athletico are without top scorer Viveros.

fix.summary: Quality-gate checks for unresearched Top 10 picks: Mobley out again for Cleveland, Larsson back from illness for Miami, UMass QB Watson's status unconfirmed.

NBA-DET-at-SA-1118.summary: Detroit arrives thin on the wing: Duren, Holland, Prince and Robinson are out and Isaiah Joe is doubtful, so Huerter has been soaking up big bench minutes (nearly 38 on Nov 14). San Antonio gets De'Aaron Fox back from a hip issue (off the Nov 16 report after missing Sunday), which sends Champagnie back to the bench. Spurs are about 9-point favorites (opened 8.5), total about 223 (opened 220.5), so blowout risk trims Detroit starters' late minutes.

NBA-NY-at-TOR-1118.summary: This is a quick rematch in Toronto two days after the Nov 15 meeting. Scottie Barnes returned in that game from a left groin strain that cost him four games and posted a full stat line, so he looks fully back. New York lists nobody on its injury report; Toronto is still without Kawhi Leonard (knee) and Nate Bittle (foot). Knicks favored by about 3, total around 217.
